clinical_protocol_card.title: Postpartum Hemorrhage (PPH) Management & Oxytocin Protocol
clinical_protocol_card.first_line_test: Visual estimation of blood loss (graduated drape) & Uterine Tone Assessment
clinical_protocol_card.test_procedure: Place a clean graduated blood collection drape immediately after delivery. Assess uterine tone (atonic vs. contracted) via abdominal palpation every 15 minutes for the first two hours. Monitor maternal pulse, blood pressure, and capillary refill.
clinical_protocol_card.recommended_dosage: 10 IU IM or IV (slow push over 1 minute) immediately after the delivery of the anterior shoulder (AMTSL) or for therapeutic management of PPH. For infusion, add 20 IU Oxytocin to 500 mL Normal Saline or Ringer's Lactate.
clinical_protocol_card.reconstitution_instructions: Oxytocin ampoules/vials are supplied as a liquid solution containing 10 IU/mL. No reconstitution is required; draw directly into a sterile syringe.
clinical_protocol_card.infusion_rate: Maintenance infusion: 40-80 milliunits/min (10-20 drops per minute) to keep the uterus contracted. If active bleeding persists, run IV infusion rapidly at 250-500 mL/hour while preparing secondary uterotonics.
clinical_protocol_card.emergency_antidote_on_standby: Misoprostol 800 mcg sublingual (if Oxytocin fails or is unavailable) and Tranexamic Acid (TXA) 1 g IV slow push over 10 minutes.
clinical_protocol_card.repeat_criteria: If uterine atony persists despite initial 10 IU Oxytocin and rapid infusion, administer secondary uterotonics: Carboprost 250 mcg IM (contraindicated in asthma) or Methylergometrine 0.2 mg IM (contraindicated in hypertension/eclampsia), along with bimanual uterine compression and referral.
clinical_protocol_card.cold_chain_warning: CRITICAL COLD-CHAIN REQUIREMENT: Store Oxytocin strictly between +2°C and +8°C. Protect from freezing and direct sunlight. Discard any ampoule exposed to ambient temperatures exceeding 25°C for more than 4 weeks or showing signs of freezing.
clinical_protocol_card.authority_guideline: Government of India Dakshata Clinical Protocols & WHO Guidelines for the Management of Postpartum Haemorrhage

clinical_protocol_card.title: National Snakebite Envenomation Protocol (Polyvalent ASV)
clinical_protocol_card.test_procedure: Collect 2ml fresh venous blood in clean dry glass tube. Keep undisturbed for 20 mins. Invert tube: if blood liquid/unclotted, envenomation confirmed.
clinical_protocol_card.reconstitution_instructions: Reconstitute each vial with 10ml sterile water. Dilute in 200ml 0.9% Normal Saline or 5% Dextrose.
clinical_protocol_card.infusion_rate: Infuse slowly over 60 minutes. Stay at bedside for first 15 minutes to monitor for anaphylaxis.
clinical_protocol_card.emergency_antidote_on_standby: Inj. Adrenaline (Epinephrine) 1:1000 (0.5ml IM) must be drawn and ready at bedside.
clinical_protocol_card.repeat_criteria: Repeat 20WBCT after 1 hour. If unclotted, administer 2nd dose of 10 vials.
clinical_protocol_card.cold_chain_warning: Maintain ASV vials at 2°C–8°C in ILR until reconstitution. Do NOT freeze diluent.
clinical_protocol_card.authority_guideline: Standard Treatment Guidelines, MoHFW / WHO SEARO 2024
